{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericRecordStructFromReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct PlainStructItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public string Key { get; set; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n            {\n                [Key(1)]\n                public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n\n                [Key(2)]\n                public PlainStructItem<string> SecondMember { get; init; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Contains(runResult.GeneratedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithAllowPrivate_DoesNotThrowIndexOutOfRange()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject(AllowPrivate = true)]\n            public partial struct AllowPrivateItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            public class OuterNonPartial\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject(AllowPrivate = true)]\n                public partial struct NestedAllowPrivateItem<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n            {\n                [Key(1)]\n                public AllowPrivateItem<int> First { get; init; }\n\n                [Key(2)]\n                public OuterNonPartial.NestedAllowPrivateItem<int> Second { get; init; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Contains(runResult.GeneratedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithInvalidConstructors_DoesNotThrowIndexOutOfRange()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct NoMatchingCtorItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public T Value { get; }\n\n                public NoMatchingCtorItem(int unrelated)\n                {\n                    Value = default!;\n                }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct MultipleSerializationCtorItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n\n                [SerializationConstructor]\n                public MultipleSerializationCtorItem(T value) => Value = value;\n\n                [SerializationConstructor]\n                public MultipleSerializationCtorItem(T value, int extra) => Value = value;\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n            {\n                [Key(1)]\n                public NoMatchingCtorItem<int> First { get; init; }\n\n                [Key(2)]\n                public MultipleSerializationCtorItem<int> Second { get; init; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithoutMessagePackObjectAttribute_DoesNotThrowIndexOutOfRange()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            public struct UnannotatedItem<T>\n            {\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n            {\n                [Key(1)]\n                public UnannotatedItem<int> Member { get; init; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithMemberAndKeyDiagnostics_DoesNotThrowIndexOutOfRange()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct MissingKeyItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n\n                public int Unkeyed { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct NullKeyItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key((string)null!)]\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public struct MixedKeysItem<T>\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public T First { get; set; }\n\n                [Key(\"second\")]\n                public string Second { get; set; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n            {\n                [Key(1)]\n                public MissingKeyItem<int> First { get; init; }\n\n                [Key(2)]\n                public NullKeyItem<int> Second { get; init; }\n\n                [Key(3)]\n                public MixedKeysItem<int> Third { get; init; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(GeneratorDriverRunResult RunResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> GeneratorDiagnostics, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> AnalyzerDiagnostics)> RunGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] baseReferences = frameworkReferences.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        CSharpCompilationOptions compilationOptions = new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        using MemoryStream libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n\n        MetadataReference[] appReferences = baseReferences.Concat(new[] { libReference }).ToArray();\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            appReferences,\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        return (runResult, generatorDiagnostics, analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"}
